_doc: Entry for the future rules registry (matrix G08). Same keys as docs/rules/merge-gate.json: id, rule, mechanism, test (Class.method inside test_file, resolved by Wiring.test_rules_registry_entry), source, enforcement.

rules.rule: No agent stops a process that is not its own: its agent process tree, pids it started with `kill_guard.py spawn`, or processes whose cwd or program is in its work dir, scratch or worktree. A supervisor may also stop processes of projects it supervises; Fable/Astra any process except the protected list (harness daemons, log backup, staging/live). Broad kills (pkill, killall, kill -1 ...) resolve against the process table. A live `ah approve kill` record lifts a role refusal; init, the agent session and system processes are never stopped. Reads, --help, prose and quoted text are never refused; when unsure the command is allowed with one audit line.
rules.mechanism: PreToolUse hook harness/hooks/kill_guard.py through ah_hook.py (Claude Code: Bash and PowerShell; Codex: PreToolUse, no matcher). Fails open: a crash or an unreadable command allows. Policy in kill_guard_policy.json. Audit log and spawn ledger under ~/.agent-harness/state/kill-guard/.
rules.source: ticket:GoodQA goodqa#14506 (matrix X05, G08); incident: pgrep -f into xargs kill and pkill -f stopped other owners' test runs, coordinator relay 2026-11-04
